licence.name: އެއްގަމު އުޅަނދު ދުއްވުމުގެ ލައިސަންސް (driving licence for land vehicles, category B1)

note: Read 2026-11-03 in the Government Gazette (gazette.gov.mv's own search, its PDFs on its storage), the Thaana text extracted and put back in reading order. Regulation 2021/R-102 on issuing driving licences for land vehicles, art. 9(ށ): a licence may be applied for from eighteen (category B1, passenger vehicles of up to nine seats). Art. 6: a first licence is temporary, valid one year from issue; when it ends the permanent licence follows, renewed every ten years; 2022/R-95 gives the permanent licence to citizens and to foreigners married to Maldivians, and 2025/R-33 gives other foreigners a temporary licence renewed yearly. The form holds the licence from eighteen (the age it's first held, as the lead ruled), its ten years (the permanent licence's; the first temporary year and foreigners' yearly licence aren't held). Art. 23(ނ): MVR 250 for a newly issued licence card, operating permit and licence book, and 250 to renew one on expiry (23(ރ)); 2025/R-33 adds art. 23(ޅ) for its special licences and leaves 23(ނ) as it was. The tests (MVR 100 each, theory and practical) aren't held. No identity card and no exchange list were read.

sources.title: Regulation No. 2021/R-102 (Regulation on Issuing Driving Licences for Land Vehicles), Dhivehi Sarukaaruge Gazette, Vol. 50, No. 229, 15 July 2021 (listed at https://gazette.gov.mv/gazette/6178)
sources.said: ދާއިމީ ލައިސަންސްއަކީ ، ކޮންމެ 10 (ދިހައެއް) އަހަރަކުން އައުކުރަންޖެހޭ ލައިސަންސެކެވެ. ... ހުށަހަޅޭނީ ، މިލާދީގޮތުން 18 ( އަށާރަ ) އަހަރު ފުރިފައިވާ މީހުންނަށެވެ. ... އޮޕަރޭޓިނގް ޕރަމިޓާއި ، ލައިސަންސް ފޮތަށް 250/- ( ދުއިސައްތަ ފަންސާސް ) ރުފިޔާ

sources.title: Regulation No. 2022/R-95, 1st amendment to 2021/R-102, Gazette Vol. 51, No. 134, 5 June 2022 (listed at https://gazette.gov.mv/gazette/6430)
sources.said: ދާއިމީ ލައިސަންސަކީ، ލައިސަންސް ނަގައިފައިވާ ދިވެހި ރައްޔިތުންނަށާއި، ދިވެހިންނާ ކައިވެނިކޮށްގެން އުޅޭ ބިދޭސީ ފަރާތްތަކަށް ދޫކޮށްފައިވާ ވަގުތީ ލައިސަންސްގެ މުއްދަތު ހަމަވުމުން ދޫކުރާ ލައިސަންސެކެވެ. ދާއިމީ ލައިސަންސަކީ، ކޮންމެ 10 (ދިހައެއް) އަހަރަކުން އައުކުރަންޖެހޭ ލައިސަންސެކެވެ.

sources.title: Regulation No. 2025/R-33, 2nd amendment to 2021/R-102, Gazette Vol. 54, No. 63, 13 April 2025 (listed at https://gazette.gov.mv/gazette/7230)
sources.said: It amends arts. 5, 6, 7, 12, 15 and 23 (adding 23(ޅ): ... ޚިދުމަތަށް އެދޭ ފަރާތުން 250/- ( ދުއިސައްތަ ފަންސާސް ) ރުފިޔާގެ ފީއެއް ދައްކަންވާނެއެވެ) and leaves art. 9(ށ) and art. 23(ނ) as they were.
